performance.verdict: ROAS holding but purchase volume thinning — spend cut is the culprit, not the creative.

findings.text: 28-day ROAS is 4.73x on $1,479.52 spend, but the last 3 days (Sep 12–14) show 1 purchase vs 8 purchases in prior 3 days (Sep 9–11) — a confirmed 3-day collapse in conversion volume.
Daily spend dropped to $38.06, $62.62, $55.43 (avg $52.04) in last 3 days vs $57.44, $52.36, $40.60 prior — spend down ~18% 7d/7d is directly compressing delivery and purchase opportunity.
OVERDUE Aug 31: Funnel test (100% off code) and UTM live milestone unconfirmed — attribution gap means Windsor/Meta revenue figures cannot be fully trusted at current.
OVERDUE Aug 31: Pre-launch gate and platform ownership audit both uncleared — two Admin/CRM milestones past due, blocking renewal phase go-live.
GBP actions fell 50% 7d/7d and show zero actions on Sep 13–14 — organic local demand signal has gone dark at exactly the moment paid reach is also contracting.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta daily budget to ~$70/day (+20% vs recent $52 avg) to recover delivery lost in the 18% spend pullback.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend averaged $52.04/day over the last 3 days vs a 28-day run rate implying ~$53/day, but the 7d pullback of 18.36% compressed delivery and drove purchases from 8 (Sep 9–11) to 1 (Sep 12–14). Raise the daily budget cap to $70/day — a ~20% step up, not a double. Success check: purchases return to 2–3/day within 5 days (by Sep 20) without ROAS falling below 4.0x on Windsor attribution. Review again Sep 20.

suggestions.text: Close the Aug 31 funnel test (UTM + conversion code) immediately; attribution cannot be confirmed until this is resolved.
suggestions.monday_update: The Aug 31 milestone 'Funnel test closed + UTM live' is overdue. Until UTMs fire consistently and the 100% off conversion code (ihbp8pmtn8) test is concluded, purchase attribution via Windsor vs Shopify cannot be reconciled. Owner (Khurram / Ads — Meta) to close the test and confirm UTM parameter firing this week. Success check: Windsor and Shopify purchase counts are within a reconcilable variance by Sep 19.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: two consecutive zero-action days (Sep 13–14) after a 50% 7d drop — confirm data feed before acting.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit zero on Sep 13 and Sep 14, following a 50% week-over-week decline. This may be a reporting lag in the data feed rather than a true organic drop. Verify GBP data pull is live and complete for those dates by Sep 17. If confirmed zero, investigate profile status and any recent listing changes. Re-check Sep 18.
